title: Benchmarking Classical and Transformer-Based Models for Document Sensitivity Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.16928v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic sensitivity classification of organizational documents is a critical yet underserved problem, where the consequences of misclassification range from regulatory violations to security breaches. While AI-based approaches offer a scalable alternative to manual review, their reliability depends fundamentally on the integrity of training data. A pervasive but underreported problem in this domain is label leakage: residual classification markers embedded within document bodies that allow models to exploit surface shortcuts rather than learning genuine content-based sensitivity signals, producing performance estimates that are inflated and unreliable. This paper addresses this problem by introducing Strategic 16K, a carefully constructed, leakage-controlled corpus of 16,000 diplomatic cables sourced from the WikiLeaks Public Library of US Diplomacy (PlusD), and presents a systematic benchmark evaluating six model architectures spannin

translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16928v1 公告类型：新 摘要：组织文档的自动敏感性分类是一个关键但未得到充分解决的问题，其中错误分类的后果从违反法规到安全漏洞不等。虽然基于人工智能的方法为人工审查提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但其可靠性从根本上依赖于训练数据的完整性。该领域一个普遍但未被充分报道的问题是标签泄漏：嵌入在文档主体中的残留分类标记，使模型能够利用表面捷径而非学习真正基于内容的敏感性信号，从而产生膨胀且不可靠的性能估计。本文通过引入Strategic 16K来解决这个问题，这是一个精心构建、控制泄漏的语料库，包含来自维基解密美国外交公共图书馆（PlusD）的16,000份外交电报，并提出了一个系统性基准测试，评估了六种模型架构，涵盖...
tldr: 本文提出了一种控制标签泄漏的Strategic 16K语料库，并系统评估了六种模型架构，以解决文档敏感性分类中因标签泄漏导致的性能高估问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the leakage-controlled Strategic 16K corpus and systematically benchmarks six model architectures to address the inflated performance estimates caused by label leakage in document sensitivity classification.
